fields.title: [TEST] Remote control holder for the side of the couch
fields.purpose: Holds three TV/streaming remotes next to the couch so they stop disappearing between the cushions. Sits on the armrest or hangs over it.
fields.dimensions: Remotes ~45 x 20 x 180, 40 x 18 x 150, 38 x 15 x 140; couch arm 150 wide, 25 thick fabric-covered

fields.name: Matthew Reda

request.text:
Your name: Matthew Reda
Your e-mail: m.reda94@gmail.com
What do you need: [TEST] Remote control holder for the side of the couch
What is it for: Holds three TV/streaming remotes next to the couch so they stop disappearing between the cushions. Sits on the armrest or hangs over it.
Sizes it must fit (mm): Remotes ~45 x 20 x 180, 40 x 18 x 150, 38 x 15 x 140; couch arm 150 wide, 25 thick fabric-covered
How many: 1
Material and colour: PLA, Black
When do you need it: 2026-10-01
Anything else: Test request submitted through the API to check the Jira form -> tickets pipeline. No screws or adhesive; must not scratch the fabric.

quotes.note: This is one piece that sits over the couch arm: a flat saddle across the top, a short leg down the seat side, and a block of three pockets hanging down the outside. No screws or glue; the remotes' weight holds it against the arm. Every edge that touches the fabric is rounded, and the underside has four shallow seats for stick-on felt dots (12 mm) so nothing rubs the upholstery. Each pocket is 2 mm bigger than the remote and half its length deep, so the top half of each remote stays in reach. Two things I assumed and would like you to check: (1) I read 'couch arm 150 wide, 25 thick' as a 150 mm wide, roughly flat arm top, with the 25 mm being the padding; if the arm is rounded or narrower, tell me its width at the top and I will adjust the saddle. (2) The caddy runs 140 mm along the arm; say if you want it shorter.
quotes.subject: [PRINT-1] Quote r1: [TEST] Remote control holder for the side of the couch

quotes.note: Revision 2, with the two changes you asked for: the saddle now fits a 140 mm wide arm (144 mm inside, the same 4 mm of play as before), and each pocket is 40% of its remote's length deep instead of half (72, 60 and 56 mm), so more of each remote sticks out to grab. Nothing else changed. The caddy is now 175 x 140 x 74 mm and a little lighter, so the price came down.
